PXWORD — 3×5 pixel wordmark renderer

PXWORD generates deterministic, editable pixel typography as SVG or PNG. It is a renderer, not a conventional font service.

Studio: https://pxword.com/
API guide: https://pxword.com/docs/api
OpenAPI 3.1 contract: https://pxword.com/openapi.yaml
Agent skill: https://pxword.com/SKILL.md
License: https://pxword.com/license

Render endpoint: GET or POST https://pxword.com/api/v1/render
Formats: svg (default), png
Determinism: pass colorMode=random and an integer seed
Limits: 160 characters, 8 lines, 60 requests/minute/IP, 16384px/edge, 64 million pixels

The 3×5 glyph shapes are CC0-1.0 with no attribution required. App source is MIT. PXWORD name and logo are excluded.
